name: College First (grades 11 and 12)
org: Chicago Botanic Garden, Science Career Continuum
what_you_do: Rising CPS juniors and seniors take a college-level environmental science class and get a mentor. They do a summer research project. Through the school year they get help with college applications. The job is paid, with school-year stipends.
who_can_apply: Chicago Public Schools students going into grade 11 or 12.
pay_detail: A paycheck in summer and stipends during the school year. Rates not stated.
duration: 7 weeks in summer, then monthly meetings through the school year
deadline_text: Page says the application deadline is Tuesday, April 15 (no year shown).
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link in the College First section of the Science Career Continuum page.
notes: The page lists "Tuesday, April 15" with no year. April 15 fell on a Tuesday in 2025, so this looks like an older date. Check the page for the next deadline. The program runs at the Chicago Botanic Garden; transportation is provided.
